C1072.title: Behind the Hidden Cameras in Shijiazhuang Homestays: Where Do the Illicit Recordings End Up?
C1072.summary: In September 2024, Shijiazhuang police received a report about a pinhole camera discovered in an apartment room. Investigation led to the arrest of three suspects—Wang Mouhua, Wang Moujie, and Li Mou—on September 24 on charges of illegally using specialized eavesdropping and recording equipment.
